name: Whoxy WHOIS API (WHOIS history and reverse WHOIS)
tier_rationale: Small company with public API documentation, terms and prepaid credits (A8 community); P022 chair rationale: 'Whoxy and WhoisFreaks are small companies'. A separate fragment from whoxy.json (batch p2-G14-1: manual pivot pages on www.whoxy.com, never fetched), like transparencia_api: the keyed API needs its own key block and credit quota.

reliability.justification: Third-party WHOIS crawl and history; post-GDPR records are mostly redacted and registry data stays authoritative.

error_markers.reason: Whoxy API: query balance exhausted (status 0 in an HTTP 200 answer, could not verify)
Whoxy API: too many requests (status 0 in an HTTP 200 answer, could not verify)

whoxy.description: Whoxy API key (prepaid WHOIS history / reverse WHOIS queries), sent as ?key= and masked by the central redactor (AR01)
whoxy.plan_hint: business = company-paid Whoxy credits recorded with the purchase in licence_allow (P022 cond 1); never an analyst's personal account

api.title: Whoxy API ?history={domain} (WHOIS history) and ?reverse=whois&email=|name=|company= (reverse WHOIS, paged)

terms.quote: Company-paid keys only; legal records the licence/purchase in licence_allow before an adapter runs under corporate (P022 cond 1). Terms 'license' (paid credits).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P022 cond 1, chair rationale). Research C0044: keyless/invalid key answers HTTP 200 {"status":0,"status_reason":"Invalid API Key"} (real fixture): the module maps it to NEEDS_KEY (P022 cond 7); balance and rate texts are provider markers. The key travels in the URL (?key=), so only through ctx.http params and the central redactor (AR01, P022 cond 1). Rule 7 open point: whoxy.com pages show a public 'RECENT WHOIS LOOKUP' list; until a team-key check shows API lookups never appear there, the adapter is off by default (setting whois_history_keyed_providers, docs/backlog/p3-G01-2.md). Used by whois_history_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-2 (P022 whois_history_keyed). Cache 30 days (P022 cond 7). Prepaid credits: the quota block is a request budget (published false until the team plan is recorded); the module also keeps a monthly credit budget per adapter.
